question: Should any prior non-empty message sent to the same conversation suppress the generated-media fallback caption, or must suppression prove that the prior message is the caption for this completion?
rationale: The existing result record shown by this PR carries destination and text but no explicit completion/caption linkage, so choosing the durable suppression contract requires product and delivery-owner intent.

options.title: Require completion-linked caption evidence
options.body: Only omit the generic caption when delivery metadata proves that the prior visible text belongs to the same generated-media completion; retain it otherwise.

options.title: Accept target-only suppression
options.body: Treat any successful non-empty same-target message as sufficient and accept possible bare generated-media attachments after unrelated messages.

recommendation.title: Require completion-linked caption evidence
recommendation.body: Only omit the generic caption when delivery metadata proves that the prior visible text belongs to the same generated-media completion; retain it otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely routing candidate for a cross-channel agent-delivery behavior contract; feature-history confirmation is still needed.
